purpose: Credit a helpful person, action, or condition for a good result.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain form + おかげで; noun + の / な-adjective + な + おかげで
Thanks to my teacher, my research progressed.
Thanks to leaving early, I caught the train.
Thanks to the good weather, the photos came out well.
formation: Plain form + おかげで; noun + の / な-adjective + な + おかげで
restrictions: Usually positive; irony is possible but depends strongly on context.
mistake: Use せいで to straightforwardly blame an unwanted cause.
